title: Baby Colin's Snowy Sleepover
world: A gentle, storybook Mount Everest in early spring: soft white snowfields, pale blue sky, prayer-flag bunting fluttering in the breeze, and a little orange tent. Signature colours: snow white, sky blue #A9C6DE, tent orange #D9783F and flag reds, yellows and greens.

hero.name: Bby Colin
hero.look:
Rolo is a cheeky, chubby 6-month-old human baby boy shown in a front-facing seated reference pose. He sits upright on soft grass with his legs out in front, soles turned to the viewer.

PROPORTIONS: His head is a big circle (radius about 40) that overlaps the top of a soft pear-shaped body. The head is roughly half his seated height. He has a round tummy and short, chubby, dimpled limbs. His hands are rounded mittens with a thumb bump.

SKIN: Light #F2D6C2 wash, with a #D9A882 glaze on the lower

companions.name: Pebble
companions.look: a little penguin with a slate back and flippers (#4E5B66), a creamy white front (#F2EFE6), an orange beak and feet (#D99447); waddles and slides on its tummy

companions.name: Puff
companions.look: a small soft cloud (#EEF0EE, blue-grey underside #C7D0D4) with rosy cheeks and a tiny face that can float and sprinkle little showers; dreamy and kind

cast.name: Mrs Muffle
cast.look: A shaggy mountain yak, round and woolly, about four times as tall as Baby Colin; long brown coat #6B4A35 with a cream-grey fringe #CFC4B2; curved pale horns, a knitted red bobble hat #B5402F perched between them, a little bell on a ribbon round her neck; gentle brown eyes, sleepy, polite expression; speaks slowly in a deep, booming voice.

cast.name: The Pika Triplets
cast.look: Three tiny round mountain pikas, each about as tall as Baby Colin's hand; soft sandy-grey fur #A89A86 with a cream tummy #E8DFCC; big round pink-lined ears #D9A3A0, no visible tail, little black whiskers; bright black bead eyes, hopeful and shy; the smallest wears a tiny green knitted scarf #6F8F5A. They squeak in high, polite little voices.

places.about: Inside a little orange tent: a blue sleeping bag on the left, a glowing brass lantern in the middle, a tin mug and pillow on the right, and the round tent flap door on the right side.
A snowy mountain ledge with the little orange tent in the middle, prayer-flag bunting strung from the tent to a rock on the left, and tall white peaks behind under a pale evening sky.
A snowy mountain ledge with prayer-flag bunting strung on poles on the left, the little orange tent on the right, and soft white peaks rising behind.
A cosy dome-shaped snow den on the snowy ledge, its round doorway in the middle, prayer-flag bunting on the left, the little orange tent beside it on the right, starry white peaks behind.
A wide snowy ledge on the gentle mountain at night, with the round snow den on the left, the little orange tent on the right, and prayer-flag bunting strung across the starry sky behind.

pages.text: Whoosh! Down the snowy hill slid Pebble the penguin, with Baby Colin giggling on his tummy. Puff the cloud floated behind them. "Faster!" squeaked Pebble. Baby Colin waved his red mitten. "Ba!" Today they were camping on the tallest mountain of all!
pages.picture: Wide shot of a snowy mountain ledge in bright day: orange tent on the left, colourful prayer flags behind, a tall snowy peak on the right. Pebble the penguin slides belly-first down the slope towards us, flippers stretched out, beak wide in delight; Baby Colin, wearing one red knitted mitten, sits on Pebble's back laughing, arms up. Puff the little cloud floats just behind them with puffed rosy cheeks.

pages.text: They wriggled inside their little orange tent. It was snug for three. Puff sprinkled a tiny shower into the tin mug. "Hot cocoa water!" he sighed dreamily. Baby Colin tucked his red mitten under the pillow. Then... something scratched the door.
pages.picture: Mid shot inside the cosy orange tent in golden light: fluffy blue sleeping bag on the left, lantern and tin mug in the middle, tent flap on the right. Baby Colin sits in the sleeping bag tucking one red mitten under a pillow; Pebble the penguin snuggles beside him; Puff the cloud hovers over the tin mug, raining a tiny shower into it. All three turn wide-eyed toward the tent flap, which bulges as if scratched from outside.

pages.text: In poked a great hairy nose. Then horns. Then a red bobble hat! "Excuse me," boomed a shaggy yak. "I'm Mrs Muffle. It's terribly chilly. May I squeeze in?" Pebble gulped. The tent was already full!
pages.picture: Close-up inside the orange tent in golden light, tent flap on the right pushed open. Mrs Muffle the yak's huge woolly head pokes through, red bobble hat between her horns, bell on her neck, eyes hopeful. Baby Colin on the blue sleeping bag stares with round eyes and an open mouth; Pebble the penguin clutches his flippers to his cheeks; Puff the cloud hides behind the lantern, peeking out.

pages.text: "Mrs Muffle, have you any treats?" asked Pebble hopefully. "Oh, how kind of you to ask!" boomed Mrs Muffle. Off she trotted through the snow, her bell going jingle-jangle, and back she came with a basket of warm honey buns.
pages.picture: Wide shot of the snowy mountain ledge at dusk: the little orange tent in the middle, prayer-flag bunting fluttering from tent to rock on the left, white peaks behind. Mrs Muffle the shaggy brown yak, red bobble hat between her horns, trots happily towards the tent, legs mid-stride, a wicker basket of golden honey buns hanging from her mouth, bell swinging. Baby Colin peeks out of the tent flap with a red mitten, mouth open in delight; Pebble the penguin beside him flaps his flippers; Puff the cloud floats above the tent smiling.

pages.text: In she came, horns first. The little orange tent wobbled this way. It wobbled that way. Pebble was squashed against Puff. Baby Colin was squashed against the cocoa. "Lovely and cosy!" boomed Mrs Muffle, sitting right on the lantern. "Oh dear."
pages.picture: Mid shot inside the little orange tent in golden lantern light: blue sleeping bag on the left, tin mug on the right. Mrs Muffle the huge woolly yak, red bobble hat and bell, wriggles in head first, her body pushing the orange walls outward so they bulge and lean. Pebble the penguin is squashed flat against Puff the cloud on the left, both with wide eyes; Baby Colin, red mitten on, leans against the tin mug, giggling. The brass lantern peeks out from under Mrs Muffle's bottom.

pages.text: They shared the honey buns, one each. Baby Colin nibbled his bun all round the edges. "Ba!" he said, very sticky. Then Mrs Muffle's nose twitched. "AH... AH... CHOO!" Out of the back of the tent popped her great fluffy bottom!
pages.picture: Mid shot inside the little orange tent, golden lantern glow, blue sleeping bag on the left. Baby Colin sits in front holding a honey bun in both hands, nibbling the edge, crumbs and honey on his cheeks, red mitten on. Pebble the penguin and Puff the cloud each hold a bun, staring up in surprise as Mrs Muffle the yak, red bobble hat flying off her head, sneezes hugely; the back wall of the tent has burst open and her woolly brown bottom sticks out into the snow.

pages.text: Outside, in the snow, sat three tiny pikas with pink ears. They shivered and sniffed at the honey buns. "We smelled supper," squeaked the smallest. "Is there room for us?" Pebble looked at the tent. Mrs Muffle's bottom filled half of it!
pages.picture: Wide shot of the snowy mountain ledge at dusk, prayer-flag bunting on the left, white peaks behind. The little orange tent sags in the middle with Mrs Muffle the yak's woolly brown bottom poking out the back. In the foreground, the three tiny Pika Triplets huddle in the snow, shivering, noses lifted, the smallest in a green scarf. Baby Colin, Pebble the penguin and Puff the cloud peek out of the front flap on the right, looking down at them with soft, worried faces.

pages.text: "Let's build a bigger snow den!" cried Pebble. Everybody helped. Pebble scooped snow with his flippers. Mrs Muffle patted it flat with her hooves. The pikas rolled tiny snowballs. Baby Colin bashed it with both mittens. "Ba!" Up, up went the walls!
pages.picture: Mid shot on the snowy mountain ledge at dusk, prayer-flag bunting on the left, little orange tent on the right, white peaks behind. Pebble the penguin in the middle scoops snow with both flippers, beak open in a cheer; Mrs Muffle the yak in her red bobble hat pats a curved snow wall with a hoof, smiling sleepily. Three tiny Pika Triplets roll snowballs in the foreground, the smallest in a green scarf, and Baby Colin sits in the snow bashing the wall with his red mittens, laughing.

pages.text: Puff floated over the top. "I can help too!" he said dreamily, and he puffed out a flurry of snowflakes. Down they drifted, soft as feathers, and made a lovely round roof. "A snow den!" squeaked the pikas.
pages.picture: Wide shot of the snowy ledge at night, prayer-flag bunting on the left, little orange tent on the right, starry peaks behind. Puff the cloud floats above a round snow dome, cheeks rosy, eyes half closed, letting soft snowflakes drift down onto the roof. Below, Baby Colin, Pebble the penguin, Mrs Muffle the yak in her red bobble hat and the three tiny pikas gaze up, mouths open in wonder.

pages.text: In went Pebble. In went Puff and Baby Colin. In tumbled the three pikas. Then Mrs Muffle poked her head in. And her shoulders. And then... she was stuck! "Oh dear," she boomed. "I appear to be wedged."
pages.picture: Mid shot of the round snow den at night, prayer-flag bunting on the left, orange tent on the right, starry peaks behind. Mrs Muffle the yak is jammed in the round doorway up to her shoulders, red bobble hat squashed sideways, eyes wide and polite. Her woolly brown bottom and back legs stick out in the snow. Pebble peeks out past her ear, flippers on his cheeks.

pages.text: Pebble pushed. The pikas pulled. Puff huffed. But Mrs Muffle would not budge! Her big brown eyes went sad. "Perhaps I should go home," she sighed. Baby Colin held out his sticky mitten. "Ba?" What should they do?
pages.picture: Close-up at the round doorway of the snow den at night, bunting and stars behind. Mrs Muffle the yak's big gentle face fills the doorway, red bobble hat crooked, eyes sad and droopy. Baby Colin sits in front of her reaching out his red mitten to her nose, eyebrows worried; Pebble pushes at her side and the three pikas tug her fringe, the smallest in a green scarf. Puff the cloud hovers above, cheeks puffed.

pages.text: "Then we'll ALL sleep outside!" cried Pebble. Pop! Out wriggled Mrs Muffle. Everybody snuggled into her warm, woolly side, under the twinkling stars. "Room for one more?" squeaked a pika. "Always," boomed Mrs Muffle. Then the wind began to whistle...
pages.picture: Mid shot on the snowy ledge at night: the round snow den on the left, the little orange tent on the right, prayer-flag bunting and stars behind. Mrs Muffle the shaggy yak lies in the snow in her red bobble hat, smiling sleepily, while Baby Colin (red mittens), Pebble the penguin and the three pikas (smallest in a green scarf) snuggle against her woolly side. Puff the cloud floats above. A wisp of wind tugs the bunting.

pages.text: Brrr! The chilly wind tugged at the bunting. The smallest pika shivered in her green scarf. Baby Colin crawled to the tent and fetched his red mitten from under the pillow. He tucked it over her like a blanket. "Ba!" Now everyone was warm.
pages.picture: Close-up at the foot of Mrs Muffle's woolly side on the snowy ledge at night, orange tent glowing on the right, bunting fluttering behind. Baby Colin sits leaning forward, gently laying a red mitten over the tiny pika in the green scarf, smiling proudly. Pebble watches with flippers clasped, Puff hovers above beaming, the other two pikas peek out of the yak's fringe.

pages.text: Puff spread himself out like a soft, fluffy quilt over them all. "You see," yawned Pebble, "there's always room for one more when we share." "Ba," agreed Baby Colin. Then Mrs Muffle gave a great, gentle snore. Goodnight, mountain!
pages.picture: Wide shot of the snowy ledge under a sky full of stars, bunting stretched across, snow den on the left and orange tent on the right. Puff the cloud stretches wide like a quilt over the sleeping pile: Mrs Muffle in her red bobble hat, eyes closed and snoring, with Baby Colin, Pebble and the three pikas curled cosily against her, the smallest under a red mitten.
